newsitem.title: USA: EVERGREEN-CHANCELLOR MAY ADD RADIO STATION IN N.Y..
newsitem.headline: EVERGREEN-CHANCELLOR MAY ADD RADIO STATION IN N.Y..

text.p: Merger-bound Evergreen Media Corp and Chancellor Broadcasting Co said Thursday they may add a fifth FM station to their New York City radio holdings.

The companies said they secured an option, purchased for $3 million, from private Bonneville International Corp that will allow the new merged Chancellor Media Corp to add WDBZ-FM in New York, and KLDE-FM in Houston.
Also, Chancellor would swap formats and broadcast signals on its KZLA-FM in Los Angeles with Bonneville's KBIG-FM there. KZLA would switch from country music to an adult contemporary format.
Under terms of the option, Chancellor would give to Bonneville its WTOP-AM in Washington and WGMS-FM Washington as well as $57 million.
Chancellor Media has until December 31 to exercise the option.
The Los Angeles, New York and Houston markets are the nation's first, second and seventh largest radio revenue markets, respectively, Chancellor said.
